title: Taiwanese American Association New York 大紐約區 台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Association New York (TAANY, 大紐約區 台灣同鄉會) is a chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization for Taiwanese American community associations. TAANY serves the Taiwanese American community in the Greater New York area and is listed under the TAA’s East Northern (美東北) regional grouping.
